newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bunds seen extending gains as mood turns bullish.
newsitem.headline: Bunds seen extending gains as mood turns bullish.

text.p: German Bunds rose to sharp gains in late trade following a sharp rise in U.S. Treasuries in the wake of tame consumer inflation data which dealers expect to set a positive tone for the market this week.

June Bund futures were quoted at 100.71 at 1443 GMT, up 0.77 points from Monday's close, and dealers predicted the rise would accelerate if the contract convincingly breaches resistance around 100.70.
One chartwatching dealer saw Bunds in an inverted head-and-shoulders formation whose neckline runs at about 100.70.
A breach of that level would give the market a theoretical price target of 102.30/40 points, the chartwatcher said.
U.S. bonds rose after U.S. consumer price data for March was seen easing the pressure on American policy-makers to raise interest rates again.
The 0.1 percent rise in the March consumer price index was half market expectations.

Bund dealers said that the data had given sentiment a strong boost but that U.S. March industrial production and capacity utilisation data due on Wednesday would show determine whether the sentiment would persist.
